name: Minimum Password Length
reason: Observed value is below the required minimum.
remediation: Configure the minimum password length to at least 14 characters.

name: Password Complexity
remediation: Enable password complexity requirements through the applicable security policy.

name: Account Lockout Threshold
reason: Observed value falls outside the approved range.
remediation: Configure account lockout to trigger after no more than five invalid authentication attempts while avoiding a value of zero.

name: Guest Account Disabled
remediation: Disable the built-in Guest account unless a documented business requirement exists.

name: Domain Firewall Enabled
remediation: Enable the Windows Defender Firewall for the Domain profile.

name: Private Firewall Enabled
remediation: Enable the Windows Defender Firewall for the Private profile.

name: Public Firewall Enabled
remediation: Enable the Windows Defender Firewall for the Public profile.

name: Remote Desktop Exposure Review
reason: Setting is enabled and requires analyst review to confirm business justification and safeguards.
remediation: Confirm that Remote Desktop is required. If it is not needed, disable it. If required, restrict access and apply strong authentication controls.

name: Remote Desktop Network Level Authentication
remediation: Enable Network Level Authentication whenever Remote Desktop is enabled.

name: SMBv1 Disabled
remediation: Disable SMBv1 and use supported SMB protocol versions.

name: PowerShell Script Block Logging
reason: Observed value does not match baseline.
remediation: Enable PowerShell Script Block Logging to improve visibility into PowerShell activity.

name: Process Creation Auditing
remediation: Enable process creation auditing to improve endpoint investigation and detection capabilities.

name: Automatic Security Updates
remediation: Enable automatic security updates or manage the system through an approved centralized patch-management process.

name: Endpoint Protection Enabled
remediation: Enable approved endpoint protection and ensure protection services remain active.

name: Local Administrator Count
reason: Observed value exceeds the permitted maximum.
remediation: Review local administrator membership and reduce privileged accounts to the minimum required for business operations.
